_comment: Copy bank of professional, motivational toast messages shown to employees when key events occur. Each key maps to an event type; the app picks one line at random per event, never repeating the same line twice in a row. Lines are short, warm, and encouraging in clean professional English. New lines may be appended to any array without code changes.
